The one event translation the ledger export (80d5d61f) should reuse is \\u0060EarlierRecords.Exported(StoredEvent, Func\\u003CDefinitionKind, string, int, ForkBase?\\u003E)\\u0060; it returns null for an event an export leaves out (the checks event).\\n- **Gotchas:**\\n  - The export opens the store and runs \\u0060EarlierProjectRecords.CarryAsync\\u0060 before reading, so it can write to the record. That\\u0027s deliberate: a never-started home must keep its software settings.\\n  - Export sequences are renumbered with no gap and positions are remapped, so don\\u0027t compare \\u0060seq_id\\u0060 across a rebuild; event ids are what\\u0027s stable.\\n  - Rebuilding twice from one export is refused by design, because the sequences have moved.\\n  - Reading a home without changing files needs \\u0060RecordExport.ConnectUnchanged\\u0060, because a plain read-only open leaves \\u0060-wal\\u0060/\\u0060-shm\\u0060 behind.\\n- **Left undone on purpose:**\\n  - Deleting the upgrade table and refusing earlier shapes is the later task, after the owner rebuilds the live node.\\n  - No import of another node\\u0027s export, and no ledger export.\\n  - Nothing narrows \\u0060exports/\\u0060 or \\u0060record-before-rebuild-*\\u0060 at start; both are created owner-only.\\n  - The \\u0060ModuleFeedTests\\u0060 timing flake is not addressed.\\n\\n[Run 2 of 2 \\u00B7 b2532873]\\n\\n- \\u0060RecordHomes.Files\\u0060 now has an overload that takes a set of relative paths and never reads them. \\u0060RecordExportTests.OutsideTheDaemon\\u0060 uses it, which fixed the two Windows-only failures in the tests where a daemon is running or starting on the home. The fix is folded into the export feat commit.\\n- Gotcha: Windows refuses to read a file a running daemon holds (\\u0060coanda.db\\u0060, the log). Any test that compares a home\\u0027s files while a daemon is up has to skip those files before reading them.\\n- Left undone: the branch was not rebased onto the newer \\u0060origin/main\\u0060, because that would change the tested tree. The platform\\u0027s push uses the branch as it stands. I haven\\u0027t seen a Windows run of the fix yet, so the next CI run is what proves
